Top tabs with native programmatic Split, one-group mouse movement and active close; external transfer, mouse drag splitting, icons/art providers and managed handler-stack access remain unbound. Requires wxUSE_AUI and aui component. See docs/AUI-NOTEBOOK.md. Programmatic SPLIT-NOTEBOOK-PAGE preserves page parents and global catalogue identities; native selection may notify/veto after group structure commits. Split books use checked programmatic MOVE: native mouse movement is disabled until only one private group remains, with native drag hint/cursor cleanup. All mutations also reject an active native tab gesture/capture. Pinned3.2.12 has501 private tab-group ID allocations per book lifetime; split or empty-book insertion refuses exhaustion before creating unusable native tabs. Bounded native-backed STYLED-TEXT-CONTROL adapter: UTF8/container/no-wrap defaults, copied text/ranges, selected scalar/indexed selection/style/margin/indicator/fold/marker/undo/geometry/assist methods only. Whitelisted domains, codepoint-boundary byte positions,64MiB raw document and1MiB NUL-free labels/assist, copied native events and guarded lifetimes. All methods/classes remain partial; no raw SendMsg, native pointer/document ownership, built-in lexer/plugin/editor application model, general event/resource parity or worker API. Active GUI thread/session and checked native STYLED-TEXT-CONTROL lifetime. UTF-8 byte offsets, never Lisp string indices; position arguments must be codepoint boundaries. Initial/replacement UTF-8 text supports embedded NUL and total<=64MiB; font/assist strings are NUL-free<=1MiB. Integer/index domains are bounded by the adapter. Mutations reject callbacks except same-control StartStyling/SetStyling/SetStyleBytes in the exact innermost native STYLENEEDED callback. Native synchronous events and source/ancestor lifetime/native-entry guards apply; use owner-bound deferred actions for other writes. No raw SendMsg, pointer/document adoption, lexer/resource ownership, worker calls or application editor abstractions. Requires wxUSE_STC and stc component. See docs/STYLED-TEXT.md.

Known wx native dialogs/upload/popups/printing suppressed, known permission requests denied; no complete OS WebKit security/permission policy claim. Native loaded/error events can reflect prior/subframe navigation; no exact per-navigation correlation or veto API. JavaScript evaluation uses internal WKWebView evaluateJavaScript, not wxWebView::RunScriptAsync/clientData ownership. Native per-navigation veto/history-resource APIs remain unbound. Explicit URL navigation/base-URL inputs support about:blank or absolute http/https/file URLs only; native links, redirects and subresource loads are not a complete navigation sandbox. JSON script messages can originate from all frames and origins; receipt does not authenticate the sender or authorize an action.
